text:
lee: Heads-up — planning a rolling maintenance window for apac1 (2026-04-03 02:00-05:00 UTC). Tasks: NIC microcode, PSU firmware, and controlled GPU soft reboots. We'll use soft-drain on interruptible pools and pre-warm caches to avoid hard evacs. Expect ~5–10% capacity impact per cohort for ~30m each. tagging on-call and capacity owners

maria: Which specific pools are classified as "interruptible" here? Will any Dedicated tenants see interruptions?

ton y: Dedicated/reserved pools are untouched by this plan. We'll only touch ephemeral/interruptible/test pools and any unpinned autoscale pools — confirming with infra.

lee: confirmed — Dedicated stays pinned. We'll cross-region failover for latency-sensitive traffic where feasible. Maria — can you run a capacity sim on Friday to estimate backfill needs?

maria: Yep, I'll run the sim Friday morning. Quick ask: rough estimate on cost uplift for cross-region backfill?

anya: Ballpark: 12–18% extra GPU-hours for the warm backfill + ~20% extra egress for cross-region moves. Rough cost uplift could be mid-to-high thousands depending on cohort size. I'll refine after sim.

sam: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-maintenance. Preflight command you can run locally:
```
./ops/preflight.sh --region apac1 --cohorts A,B,C
```

infra-bot: Preflight completed for apac1 — WARNING: cohort-B KV-seed below threshold (82% vs required 90%). Recommend scheduling KV-seed before window.

lee: Good catch. Sam — please schedule KV-seed + bump cache retention 2h before start. Also enable adaptive batching during the window to smooth tails.

sam: Scheduled KV-seed job for 01:20 UTC. Command to trigger preheat:
```
kubectl -n infra exec job/kv-seed -- /bin/sh -c "./seed_kv.sh --cohort B --target 95"
```

maria: What's the reboot order? Thermal-sensitive racks first or last?

lee: Order: 1) low-load cohorts (A) -> 2) test/ephemeral -> 3) cohort-B (after KV-seed confirmed) -> 4) thermal-priority racks last. Drive doc with the sequence: https://redwood.internal/drive/apac1-maint-sequence.

ton y: I'll loop in account execs for any enterprise customers in apac1 that might have scheduled jobs.

anya: Also set a billing alert: cost-spike threshold at +15% baseline during window — we should get notified if exceeded.

sam: I'll be oncall for the window. Ping if latency >2x or error rate spikes above 1%. I'll have terminal open and watch the rollout dashboard.

lee: Thanks team. I'll post a 24h notice and update the status channel with the final cohort start times. :thumbsup:
